# Story 7.1: Heading below front matter

## Story

As a fixture author,
I want the H1 to sit on line 6 rather than line 1,
so that the reported source line must be the real one.

## Acceptance Criteria

1. **Given** front matter above the heading
   **When** the story is ingested
   **Then** its source line points at the heading, not at line 1.
